newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP says hydrocarbons in Timor well.
newsitem.headline: BHP says hydrocarbons in Timor well.

text.p: The BHP Petroleum unit of Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Thursday that the Kakatua North-1A well in the Timor Gap had encountered hydrocarbons and wireline logs were now being run.
BHP said the well, located in the ZOCA 91-12 permit between Australia and Indonesia, had reached a total depth of 3,300 metres.
"During the week a core was cut over the interval 3,163-3,182. Hydrocarbons have been encountered in the well," said BHP, which is the permit operator and has a 42.417 percent stake.
Other participants are Santos Ltd, with 21.436 percent, Indonesia's Inpex Sahul Ltd with 21.209 percent and Petroz Ltd with 14.948 percent.
